items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free style cleanse that won't strip already dry-feeling skin while you start a retinol.
The lower 0.3% strength is a sensible starting point for smoother-looking texture and a more even-looking tone.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to add comfort and moisture, since your scan shows low moisture.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, and this tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides gives daily protection that suits deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night just 2 evenings a week, applied after cleansing and followed by the cream, then slowly add nights as your skin feels comfortable. Apply the SPF every morning, and pause the retinol and check in with a dermatologist if skin becomes very sore, dark-looking or stays irritated.
